verdict.rationale: Feature flagging is a fair axis for a product analytics and digital adoption platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Pendo offering feature flags, cohort or property targeting for code rollouts, or percentage rollouts. Its segments apply to analytics, guides and session-replay filtering, and Pendo Validate is in-app idea testing. Both are adjacent features, not flag-based delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll out features behind flags targeted by user properties, cohorts, and percentage rollouts
